name: edge-to-edge

summary.en: Google’s Android skill for migrating a Compose app to edge-to-edge layout and fixing inset, IME and system bar issues.
summary.zh: Google 官方 Android Skill，用于把 Compose 应用迁移到全面屏布局，并修复 inset、输入法和系统栏问题。

upstreamDescription: Use this skill to migrate your Jetpack Compose app to add adaptive edge-to-edge support and troubleshoot common issues. Use this skill to fix UI components (like buttons or lists) that are obscured by or overlapping with the navigation bar or status bar, fix IME insets, and fix system bar legibility.
